mintAuthority.summary: EURSAFO is an AMF-authorized UCITS fund share. At Ethereum block 26095799, PermissionManager authorizes Minter proxy 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366 to mint EURSAFO. Its ordinary daily limit is 5,000,000 shares, but the 3-of-6 super-admin Safe can raise the limit, approve pending over-limit mints and upgrade the token, Minter and PermissionManager. The previously recorded two relayers are EUTBL/USTBL token proxies, not current EURSAFO minters; remaining operator rosters require review.

Five group-2 contracts return other fund tokens from getToken(); the sixth is the known Minter. The Ethereum initiator/approver roster is now documented in the Minter evidence. Remaining non-Ethereum operator rosters and exact principal-to-key-custody mappings remain unresolved; the issuer documents Dfns-managed relayer signing without identifying these addresses.

controls.label: EURSAFO Ethereum Minter proxy
controls.capDescription: At Ethereum block 26095799, dailyLimit(EURSAFO) is 500000000000 raw, or 5,000,000 five-decimal shares; getMintedToday(EURSAFO) is zero. Exceeding the ordinary limit creates a pending mint. A privileged approveMint call can execute that pending mint without applying the daily-limit check, and the super-admin Safe can change dailyLimit immediately. maxDelay() = 86400 is the pending-operation expiry window, not an enforced approval delay or immutable economic ceiling.
controls.evidence: The block-26095799 implementation and limit review established Minter 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366, ordinary dailyLimit(EURSAFO) = 500000000000 raw, maxDelay = 86400 and discretionary over-limit approval. At block 26098764, the same limit and expiry were re-read. getRequirements(Minter, initiateMint selector 0x7fa62fcc) = 0x401, so group 10 or admin can initiate; approveMint selector 0x442dbf77 = 0x201, so group 9 or admin can approve. This corrects the previously reversed group labels. Complete indexed GroupAdded/GroupRemoved history plus current getGroups reads identify group-10 initiators 0x7a493c05479f6132cb895c72c49439139b595eb4 and 0xe582cddcb3d2374adbb34c9afe76683d019c8a2b, both with empty eth_getCode. Group-9 approvers are 0x4896f23ff83242d8d4eb5fa1dedf8c57e9145949, 0x4d1d9c5b5d9ca448194313d799de374f362bd460, 0x6ca0aa6d3bf500d65f6e17a27af05c74ed4bfb5a, 0xd9dbe8ea915131d821279a0eb51bec0fd8affbe7, 0xda47bd72438f11bef7cc54f18cd02426dd86a5a2, 0xe67d2cbeae3090be017c66e7a6943961619a5d35 and 0xf949ca7be175a5fcbd3febb9a0235de608ca7898. All approvers except 0xd9dbe8ea915131d821279a0eb51bec0fd8affbe7 have empty code; that address has contract code. The sole group-0 principal is the previously reviewed 3-of-6 Safe. The cap remains bypassable by approval and raiseable by admin; this roster does not establish an immutable economic ceiling or the custody of any individual signing key. R05 Ethereum execution review at block 26124840 / 0x204633afc218623e2a2753eb9219585d01fde70c5fa58c24545c5bc6234d090c: independent PM history census from creation 19690257 recovered 697 events, 108 current requirement pairs on 30 targets, and all 256 group-admin masks (only group 6 adds group 5). Current privileged membership matches census. Minter, PM, both native tokens and all 11 implementations of the 17 group-2 mint targets exactly match verified deployed source bytecode. Token mint/burn/pause/UUPS all check the immutable PM using msg.sender; the trusted forwarder cannot call restricted functions, token owner is zero, proxy admin/beacon slots are zero, and self-delegatecall Multicall does not evade permissions. Minter token arguments are mutable: full root/native-liability reach and the independent ADMIN ability to change permissions, limits and implementations are retained; no deployment-local cap, collateral guarantee, signer independence or module noninterference credit is asserted. Group-9 approveMint/cancelMint and group-10 initiateMint are the only restricted Minter routes; approve requires a matching pending operation and bypasses daily limits. Both fund tokens have a 500000000000 raw-unit daily limit (5000000 shares), maxDelay 86400 is an expiry, not an unavoidable execution timelock. Approver Safe has four zero-code owners, threshold 1, terminal empty modules, zero guard/module guard, singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a and handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, both runtime/source exact; simulateAndRevert cannot persist effects. Admin Safe independently remains 3-of-6; no custody attribution inferred. Complete scope applies only to the seven narrowly-permissioned group-9/group-10 principals; Minter, richer-role callers and ADMIN system inventory remain partial.
